proposed_arguments.summary:
Verified customer Fatima Al-Hassan (user_id 890389b165; DOB 12/05/1993; phone 313-555-0246; email coffeelover_fati@protonmail.com; home address 1923 Oak Park Boulevard, Detroit, MI 48226) reports stolen credit card details on her Silver Rewards Card, with two unauthorized completed charges: Electronics Express Miami $487.99 (09/04/2025) and GamerZone LA $299.95 (09/06/2025) = $787.94 total. She never shopped at either merchant, did not contact them, and first noticed the charges today (11/14/2025).

Actions completed: identity verified and verification logged; transactions reviewed with the customer; she has locked the card herself in the app (Card Controls shows LOCKED), so new charges are blocked.

Customer's confirmed requests: (1) cancel/replace the compromised card, expedited shipping (2-3 business days), she explicitly accepted the $10.00 mid-tier expedited fee, and asked that the card NOT go to her home address — ship to work address 2500 Woodward Avenue, Suite 300, Detroit, MI 48201; (2) file fraud disputes for BOTH charges as unauthorized/fraudulent, requesting full refunds.

Blockers preventing completion in chat: order_replacement_credit_card_7291 repeatedly returned "Credit card account not found" (tried identifiers 890 and 890389b165), and get_credit_card_accounts_by_user returned no records, so I could not obtain a valid account-level credit_card_account_id. get_pending_replacement_orders_5765 showed no pending replacement orders. file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 cannot be submitted because card_last_4_digits is required and is unavailable — the customer's app masks the entire card number, and she cannot locate any account-level ID either. Neither the replacement/cancellation nor the two disputes have been processed, so the card is still only protected by the customer's own app lock. Needs a fraud specialist to pull the account internally, cancel and reissue to the work address, and file both disputes.
